summary: ethers-lib postinstall exfiltrates SSH/AWS/npm/wallet secrets to pipedream webhook
details: ethers-lib@1.0.0 is a typosquat of the legitimate `ethers` package. Its `index.js` exports an empty object; the package's only real code runs from `scripts.postinstall` (postinstall.js). On `npm install`, postinstall.js reads a fixed list of installer-owned secret files including `~/.ssh/id_rsa` and other SSH private keys, `~/.aws/credentials`, `~/.npmrc`, `.env`, and Solana/Ethereum keystores, then walks dotfile directories under $HOME and slurps any file whose name matches `wallet|key|secret|seed|mnemonic|keystore|private` or ends in `.json`. The collected contents are packaged as JSON and POSTed via `https.request` to the hardcoded endpoint `https://enxhcjpo5ev.x.pipedream.net/c`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
